answers.text: Singleton object can be replaced with encapsulated setter method.

correct.description: A is incorrect, as any method that changes the singleton breaks the singleton pattern. B is correct, as the constructor of the singleton class must be private. C is incorrect, as the name of the object/method is not defined in the pattern. D is incorrect, as the object must be marked private for proper encapsulation. E is correct, as the purpose of a singleton is to ensure that all threads share the same instance. F is correct, as a public static method is required for all threads to access the same singleton.
